# tss_secrets (Data Source)

Read a single field from multiple secrets in one Secret Server API call. Useful when several Terraform resources need values from a batch of secrets — preferable to declaring N separate `tss_secret` data sources both for performance (one round trip vs. N) and for state shape (a single typed list vs. N independent values).

For reading a single secret, use the [`tss_secret`](secret.md) data source. For reading a single secret without persisting the value to state, use the [`tss_ephemeral_secret`](../ephemeral-resources/secret.md) ephemeral resource.

Closes [GitHub issue #96](https://github.com/DelineaXPM/terraform-provider-tss/issues/96) — this data source has shipped since provider v2.0.7 but was previously undocumented on the registry page.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "tss_secrets" "db_passwords" {
  ids   = [1234, 1235, 1236]
  field = "password"
}

# Look up a single result by ID:
output "primary_db_password" {
  value     = [for s in data.tss_secrets.db_passwords.secrets : s.value if s.id == 1234][0]
  sensitive = true
}
```

The `field` argument matches a Secret Server field by its **slug** (the URL-style name; `"password"`, `"username"`, etc.) or by its display name. Match is case-insensitive. The same field name is read from every secret in `ids` — if some secrets in the list don't have a field by that name, those entries appear in the result with an empty `value`.

## Schema

### Required

- `ids` (List of Number) The list of Secret Server secret IDs to read.
- `field` (String) The slug or display name of the field to read from each secret. Same name applied across every ID in `ids`.

### Read-Only

- `secrets` (Attributes List, Sensitive) The list of `{id, value}` results, in the same order as `ids`. The `value` attribute is marked sensitive — Terraform CLI output masks it and `terraform show -json` emits the value but it is treated as sensitive. (See [Nested Schema for `secrets`](#nestedatt--secrets).)

<a id="nestedatt--secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secrets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The Secret Server secret ID, mirroring the corresponding entry in the input `ids`.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The value of `field` on this secret, retrieved from Secret Server.
